description: We’re looking for a pragmatic, security-minded Full-Stack Developer to help build and scale Fluence’s B2B products used by clinicians, researchers, and organizations in psychedelic-assisted therapy and mental health. Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management). Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus. Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team. Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively. Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools. Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process) Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. Stack Next.js (App Router) Clerk for authentication Convex for data + backend logic n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation TypeScript Requirements Public page The fictional company name is LendLoop . Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.” Show: A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex. A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk. Authenticated experience Only signed-in users can: List a tool with: name category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.) condition short description Request to borrow a tool for a date range. Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Nice, minimal layout. Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs. Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex. Secure the integration in both directions: Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side. Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON. Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders. Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently. (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”. Deliverables A GitHub repository with the app source code. Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository. A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions. A short note on what you would change to run this in production. We evaluate: Code structure and clarity Security-minded thinking UX and practicality Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n) Documentation and reasoning Interview Process Take-home assignment submission (as described above). Technical & product interview (walkthrough of your solution, architecture, security mindset, collaboration style). 6-month contract offer for the right candidate, with strong potential for renewal as a recurring contract based on performance and ownership. Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology. Why join us? 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development. 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations. 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites. 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. About us – in brief Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%. Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide. Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. Your Role – What You'll Own You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform. Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation. Your Responsibilities Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites. Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need. Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites. Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs. Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues. Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities. Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned. What You Bring We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations. Must-have – Essential Requirements The following skills and experience are essential for this position: Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage. Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure. Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management. Infrastructure Modernization A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems. Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations. Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments. Identity & Access Management Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments. Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls. Endpoint Management Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment. Resilience, Security & Monitoring Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor. Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation. Communication & Collaboration Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations. Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations. Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered. Nice-to-have – Additional Experience The following skills are beneficial but not essential: Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects. Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods. Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management. Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers. Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel. Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub. Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform. Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP. Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300. Your First 12 Months Your initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure: Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure. Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt. Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required. Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune. Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency. Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery. Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. What We Offer Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site. Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience. Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses. Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security. Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.
